camel_example: aliyun cloudfw ListWebFilterTemplates --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enable --Description 'URL访问管控' --PageSize 10 --PageNo 1 --WebFilterTemplateIds.1 'wft-3f2a9c1d4b5e6f70' --Name 'Web过滤模板' --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the web filtering templates under the current Alibaba Cloud account by using paging. Supports fuzzy search by name and description, exact filtering by status, and batch exact filtering by template IDs
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的Web过滤模板列表。支持按名称和描述信息模糊搜索，按状态精确过滤，按模板ID批量精确过滤
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw list-web-filter-templates --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --name 'Web过滤模板' --description 'URL访问管控' --status Enable --web-filter-template-ids '["wft-3f2a9c1d4b5e6f70"]' --api-version 2017-12-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListWebFilterTemplates

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码。起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围为1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the web filtering template. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: Web过滤模板名称，模糊匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the web filtering template. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: Web过滤模板描述信息，模糊匹配
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The status of the web filtering template. Exact match is supported. Valid values:
Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
Web过滤模板状态，精确匹配。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the web filtering templates for batch exact matching. You can specify up to 100 template IDs
parameters.help_zh: Web过滤模板ID列表，批量精确匹配。最多支持100个模板ID
parameters.name: web_filter_template_ids

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of web filtering templates that meet the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合过滤条件的Web过滤模板总数

WebFilterTemplates.description_en: The list of web filtering templates

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the web filtering template. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: Web过滤模板的创建时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒

Description.description_en: The description of the web filtering template
Description.example: 用于URL访问管控的Web过滤模板

Name.description_en: The name of the web filtering template

RuleActionStatistics.description_en: The statistics on the number of web filtering rules in the template categorized by action
RuleActionStatistics.description_zh: 模板内Web过滤规则按动作分类的数量统计

Alert.description_en: The number of web filtering rules whose action is Alert in the template
Alert.description_zh: 模板内动作为Alert（观察）的Web过滤规则数量

Allow.description_en: The number of web filtering rules whose action is Allow in the template
Allow.description_zh: 模板内动作为Allow（放行）的Web过滤规则数量

Deny.description_en: The number of web filtering rules whose action is Deny in the template
Deny.description_zh: 模板内动作为Deny（拦截）的Web过滤规则数量

Status.description_en:
The status of the web filtering template. Valid values:
Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
Web过滤模板的状态。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭

WebFilterTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the web filtering template
